hero.subtitle: SurgeX — AI-Powered Digital Marketing for Local Businesses

items.title: Online Presence
items.description: A premium website online in 48 hours, bilingual and ready for Google. Your business listed and kept up to date on Google Maps, Apple Maps, TripAdvisor and Bing — the same name, address, hours and photos everywhere.

items.title: Get Found
items.description: When someone nearby searches for what you do, you show up. Local SEO on Google, pages for the areas you serve, and presence in the answers of ChatGPT, Perplexity, Gemini and Google AI Overviews. We track your positions every month.

items.title: Automatic Customer Care
items.description: Your customers get an answer at any hour, even when you're busy. An AI chatbot that knows your business, a WhatsApp button with your hours, automatic follow-ups on quotes and requests, and Google review requests after every job.

items.title: Social Media & Content
items.description: A monthly calendar, posts and images created with AI in your brand's voice, published automatically on Instagram, Facebook and LinkedIn. You approve, we publish. Every month you get a report of how far it reached.

items.title: Campaigns & Outreach
items.description: New customers found for you, past customers brought back. Automatic outreach by email and WhatsApp to the people who should know you, newsletters and reactivation campaigns to your existing base, Google and Meta ads when they make sense — ad spend is your own budget, and everything is measured.

pricing.label: PRICING
pricing.headline: Simple Pricing.
pricing.description: One setup fee, then a monthly plan you can cancel anytime. No hidden fees, no surprises.

plans.title: Setup
plans.description: Everything to get your business online in 48 hours. Half at the start, half on approval of the final version.

plans.title: Presence
plans.description: Keeps your site and listings live, secure and up to date.

plans.title: Growth
plans.description: Everything in Presence, plus getting found and answering customers automatically.

plans.title: Complete
plans.description: Everything in Growth, plus social media, campaigns and a monthly results report.

pricing.note: Each plan includes exactly what is listed — nothing hidden to add later. No contract: cancel whenever you want. The monthly plan starts once you approve the site. Ad spend on Google or Meta is always extra and comes from your own budget.

items.question: How fast will my website be online?
items.answer: 48 hours on average, from the moment we have your information. You review the final version, approve it, and it goes live together with your listings on Google Maps, Apple Maps and TripAdvisor.

items.question: What does the €500 setup include?
items.answer: A premium bilingual website delivered in 48 hours, your business listed on Google Maps (Google Business Profile), Apple Maps, TripAdvisor and Bing, domain and email set up, and a first SEO optimization. You pay half at the start and half when you approve the final version.

items.question: What do I get for €35, €65 or €100 a month?
items.answer: Presence (€35) keeps your site and listings hosted, secure and up to date, with small content changes and support. Growth (€65) adds ongoing local SEO and AI search visibility, an AI chatbot, a WhatsApp button, automatic review requests and follow-ups. Complete (€100) adds social media content published automatically, campaigns and newsletters, and a monthly results report.

items.question: Can I change plan or cancel?
items.answer: Yes, at any time. There is no contract and no minimum period. Move up when you want more, move down when you want less, or cancel — no questions asked.

items.question: Do I need to understand AI to work with you?
items.answer: Not at all. AI is our engine, not your homework. You tell us about your business and your customers; we handle everything technical. You only see the results: more calls, more messages, more visits.

items.question: Do you work outside Lisbon?
items.answer: Yes. We're based in Lisbon and work 100% online, serving businesses across all of Portugal. The process is the same everywhere — a 15-minute call, your site online in 48 hours, and everything else set up remotely.
